battle.name: 沙苑之戰
battle.brief: 魏大統十三年（537）十月，東魏相國高歡率二十萬眾自蒲津南下；西魏宇文泰自恆農馳援，以不足萬人輕騎渡渭，列陣大荔沙苑渭曲。李弼鐵甲騎兵橫擊，東魏前軍被截為兩段，高歡大潰，棄甲士八萬、鎧仗十之八，俘七萬。西魏近戰骨幹為披甲槊兵與重騎，卡面羅馬重步兵的分段鎧甲配重盾並未在此出現。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 這場戰爭是東魏與西魏在北中國的第二場大規模會戰，時間在西魏大統十三年、也就是東魏天平四年（537年）十月。西魏一方由太師宇文泰總攏軍政，首都長安，名義上奉元寶炬為帝；軍隊主力是關中與關東降戶出身的六鎮將門及漢人豪族，宇文泰、獨孤信、趙貴、李虎、于謹、賀拔勝、楊忠、達奚雄、李弼等人各領一部，兵源以關中丁口與歸附的關東士家為主；關中地廣人稀，能夠常備的兵數極少。東魏一方由渤海王高歡以都督諸軍事之權柄控制河北，朝廷在鄴，擁立元善見為帝，軍隊以冀州、渤海、相州人丁與河北豪強部曲為骨幹，麾下有斛律金、斛律光、高敖曹、彭樂、孫騰、侯景等蕃漢將領，並由洛陽、虎牢方向的高敖曹一部與河南道各州郡兵擔任側翼。東魏兵多勢盛，但糧道綿長、將令不統一；西魏兵少而精，統屬單一，倚靠關中糧倉與渭北就食。兩家的對峙是534年孝武帝西奔關中、北魏正式分裂之後的必然延伸：東魏想趁西魏新立、關中空虛之際一舉吞併秦地，西魏則必須守住潼關與渭河這條關中的門戶。
countriesEn: This was the second large-scale meeting between Eastern Wei and Western Wei in northern China, fought in the tenth month of Datong 13 of Western Wei, which is Tianping 4 of Eastern Wei (537). The Western Wei side was run by the Grand Preceptor Yuwen Tai, who held military and political power at the capital of Chang'an and nominally served Yuan Baoju, emperor of Western Wei; its troops came mainly from the command families of the Six Garrisons and from Han elite families in Guanzhong and from surrendered households of the east, with Yuwen Tai, Dugu Xin, Zhao Gui, Li Hu, Yu Jin, Helu Sheng, Yang Zhong, Daxi Xiong and Li Bi each leading a wing, the manpower base being the registered households of Guanzhong together with the resettled families of the east. Guanzhong was thinly peopled, so the number of men that could be kept under arms was very small. The Eastern Wei side was controlled by the Prince of Bohai, Gao Huan, who held the authority of Commander-in-Chief over Hebei; its court sat at Ye and installed Yuan Shanxian as emperor, and its army was built on the men of Ji, Bohai and Xiang provinces and on the retainers of the great Hebei families, with such generals as Hulü Jin, Hulü Guang, Gao Ao'cao, Peng Yue, Sun Teng and Hou Jing in the roster, and with Gao Ao'cao's corps working toward Luoyang and Hulao and the troops of the Henan circuit covering the flanks. Eastern Wei had the numbers but a long supply line and divided command; Western Wei had few men but a single chain of command, and drew grain from the granaries of Guanzhong and fed in the field north of the Wei River. The confrontation was the direct continuation of the split of the Northern Wei after Emperor Xiaowu fled west to Guanzhong in 534: Eastern Wei moved to swallow Qin territory while Western Wei had to hold the gateway of Tong Pass and the Wei River.
people: 東魏的實際統帥是高歡（507至547年），字賀六渾，渤海迪氏人，早年隨爾朱氏在河北起兵，爾朱氏敗亡後在晉陽獨樹一幟，擁立元善見為帝並把持朝政，漢人與胡人將領都聚在他帳下。戰前他自蒲津大舉南下，是志在趁西魏新立、關中未固之時直取長安。帳下大將斛律金（515至572年）是北方斛律部人，善騎射、通曉音律，東魏倚為長城，他又是先前在河曲一役擊敗西魏的名將；沙苑潰敗之際，正是他看破眾心離散、不可復用，力勸高歡立刻東撤。高敖曹是高歡從弟，以驍勇聞名，率部在恆農一線圍困西魏重鎮，聽到沙苑的消息後解圍退保洛陽。西魏的宇文泰（507至556年）字黑獺，武川鎮出身，先後追隨賀拔岳、賀拔勝，534年迎北魏孝武帝入關，自此掌握西魏軍政；本役他僅以不足萬人對二十萬，仍親自擂鼓發動伏兵，臨機決斷之處見其用兵。名將李弼出身關中，善騎射，統率以重甲武裝的鐵甲騎兵，埋伏之後正是他率騎兵橫擊側翼，親手把東魏前軍切為兩段。另如獨孤信、趙貴、于謹、楊忠、達奚雄各領一翼，韋護在蒲坂拒守高歡，與守恆農的王思政互相策應，構成本役西魏多路呼應、彼此帶動的骨架。
peopleEn: The real commander of Eastern Wei was Gao Huan (507 to 547), courtesy name Heluhun, of the Di clan of Bohai, who had risen in Hebei with the Erzhu clan and, after their collapse, made himself master of the armies at Jinyang, setting up Yuan Shanxian as emperor while keeping the court in his hands. Before the battle he marched south in force from Puzhou, resolved to seize Chang'an while Western Wei was young and Guanzhong still unguarded. His general Hulü Jin (515 to 572), a Helü tribal northerner skilled with bow and horse and versed in music, was a pillar of Eastern Wei and had already beaten Yuwen Tai at Hequ; at Shayuan it was he who read the state of the army, that the men's heart had scattered and the force could not be used again, and who urged Gao Huan to fall back east at once. Gao Ao'cao, Gao Huan's cousin and a celebrated warrior, was besieging the Western Wei stronghold at Hengnong, and he lifted that siege to fall back on Luoyang when he heard of the defeat. On the Western Wei side Yuwen Tai (507 to 556), courtesy name Heita, came from Wuchuan and served first Huba Yue and then Huba Sheng; in 534 he brought Emperor Xiaowu of Northern Wei into Guanzhong and took charge of Western Wei's military government, and in this campaign he faced 200,000 men with fewer than 10,000 and still beat the drum in person to launch the ambush. Li Bi, a famous Western Wei commander of Guanzhong origin, an expert horseman and archer, led the iron-armoured cavalry, and it was his charge across the flank after the ambush that cut the Eastern Wei advance in two. Others such as Dugu Xin, Zhao Gui, Yu Jin, Yang Zhong and Daxi Xiong led the wings, Wei Hu held Puzhou against Gao Huan, and Wang Sizheng, who defended Hengnong, supported them; together these formed the framework of Western Wei's mutually supporting deployment.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬重步兵是共和國晚期的形象：狹長的弧面大盾護住正面，分段式的鐵甲覆住胸背，步兵在方陣中以盾牆承擔正面衝擊。它是歐洲重裝步卒的原型，與537年的沙苑之戰相隔近一千年，戰場上不可能出現任何羅馬兵員；但它所代表的那套戰鬥邏輯——以披甲近戰步兵頂住第一波衝鋒、以工整陣形換取正面交換、靠補充兵源與補給線而非重裝本身維持戰力——在關中戰場上同樣成立，只是執行者換成了東西兩魏的披甲槊兵。本役雙方步兵的主要裝備是長槊，配合各樣式的盾與鎧甲，遠射用弓、箭與矟，近身則靠環首刀與直刃刀；守禦器械之中以橦最接近卡面的配重盾，即以大盾覆車、掩蔽進攻者的車盾，是中國式的重裝防線。騎兵才是本役真正決定勝負的力量：西魏李弼的鐵甲騎兵，兵皆著鐵甲、乘馬持槊，是全軍最鋒利的刀刃；東魏高敖曹部同樣以鐵騎三千為鋒，高歡本人統主力隨後投入。輕騎負責偵察、追擊與斷糧，東魏大軍因二十萬眾的糧道綿長，靠駱駝與輜重車運載，戰敗夜渡黃河時幾乎無船可尋，全靠少數船隻與馬匹才得渡水。號令工具簡陋而關鍵：西魏以鼓為號令伏兵起，東魏以點名官清點各營，指揮依靠傳令與陣中旗鼓。西魏備三日口糧就食於關中，東魏靠河南、河北的糧倉供應，兩家在補給線長短上的差距，才是這場以弱勝強伏擊戰的真正底色。
kitsEn: The card shows a Roman legionary of the late Republic: a tall curved scutum covering the front, a segmented iron cuirass over chest and back, the infantryman standing in the ranks behind a wall of shields. It is the archetype of European heavy infantry, and since the battle at Shayuan took place in 537, nearly a thousand years later, no Roman soldier could have been on that field; yet the logic the card stands for, heavy infantry in armour absorbing the first charge, close order bought at the price of drill, and fighting power sustained by replacements and supply rather than by armour itself, held just as firmly on the Guanzhong battlefield, only with the armoured spearmen of Eastern and Western Wei standing in for the legionaries. The principal infantry equipment on both sides was the long spear, supported by shields of various types and by body armour; bows, arrows and crossbow bolts gave the reach, while ring-pommel and straight single-edged swords settled the close work. Among the defensive devices, the che came closest to the scutum on the card, a large shield stretched over a cart body to shelter men on the assault, and it was the Chinese equivalent of a heavy defensive line. Cavalry was the arm that actually decided the battle: Li Bi's iron-armoured cavalry, armoured men riding with long spears, were Western Wei's sharpest edge, and on the other side Gao Ao'cao led three thousand iron cavalry as the vanguard with Gao Huan and the main body pressing in behind. Light horse carried out scouting, pursuit and the cutting of supply lines; the Eastern Wei host, 200,000 strong and fed by a long supply line, moved its stores and men by camel and baggage cart, and after the defeat, trying to cross the Yellow River by night, could barely find boats and got over only with a few craft and horses. The means of command were crude but decisive: the Western Wei used the drum to order the ambush, the Eastern Wei used a name-taker to check the units, and in the melee orders travelled by messenger and by flag and drum. The Western Wei marched with three days of rations and fed off the granaries of Guanzhong, while Eastern Wei drew from the depots of Henan and Hebei; that difference in the length of the supply lines, rather than the numbers in the line, was the true underside of this ambush won by the weaker side.
tactics: 本役的戰術核心是一次以少擊眾的伏擊戰。東魏二十萬眾自蒲津濟河，進抵洛水以南的許原，威逼長安；西魏諸將最初請宇文泰據渭水布陣，宇文泰則採李弼之計，把戰場選在沙苑。他從恆農趕回關中後，輕騎渡渭，於渭曲列陣，兵不滿萬、糧僅三日，距高歡大軍約六十里下營。他把主力藏在渭曲一帶的蘆葦叢中，令將士把兵器收在蘆葦之下，等候鼓聲再起；西魏的營壘因此顯得稀疏零落，東魏前鋒望見敵兵寥寥，貪功冒進，戰陣散不成形，紛紛湧入伏兵圈。兩軍接戰之際宇文泰親擂鼓號，蘆葦中的伏兵奮起，李弼的鐵甲騎兵同時從側面突出橫擊，東魏前軍被切成兩段，士卒大恐。此時高歡一度想收兵集結後再出擊，點名官卻回報眾營皆空、兵士死散、沒人應答；斛律金力勸立即東撤，高歡據鞍歎息不動，直到斛律金用鞭擊馬，一行人才奪路而走，到河邊幾乎找不到船，狼狽渡河。西魏追騎一直追到河上，斬獲甚眾；高敖曹聞訊解恆農之圍退保洛陽。戰後宇文泰令將士在戰場上按當時在役人數每人植柳樹一株，以旌武功。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the battle was an ambush by a small force against a great one. The 200,000 men of Eastern Wei crossed the Yellow River at Puzhou, reached Xu Yuan south of the Luo River and threatened Chang'an; at first the Western Wei officers asked Yuwen Tai to draw up behind the Wei River, and he took Li Bi's plan instead, choosing the ground at Shayuan. Having hurried back from Hengnong into Guanzhong, he crossed the Wei River with light horse and took position at Weiqu with fewer than 10,000 men and three days of grain, pitching camp about sixty li from Gao Huan's main body. He hid the bulk of his force in the reeds along the bend of the Wei River, ordered the weapons to be kept down under the reeds, and waited for the drum; the Western Wei camp thus looked thin and scattered, and the Eastern Wei vanguard, seeing how few enemies there were, pressed on out of greed and broke its formation as it charged into the trap. At the moment of contact Yuwen Tai beat the drum himself, the ambushers rose out of the reeds, and at the same moment Li Bi's iron cavalry struck out from the flank and cut the Eastern Wei advance in two. Gao Huan wanted at first to pull the troops together and try again, but the name-taker came back with the report that every camp was empty, the soldiers dead or scattered, and no one answering; Hulü Jin urged an immediate retreat east, and Gao Huan sat on his saddle and would not move until Hulü Jin struck the horse with his whip, and only then did the flight begin, ending at the river where they could hardly find boats and crossed in disorder. Western Wei's pursuing horse rode right down to the river, taking heavy toll, and Gao Ao'cao lifted the siege of Hengnong and fell back on Luoyang. After the battle Yuwen Tai ordered the soldiers to plant one willow tree each on the field, as many as there were men then in the service, to record the achievement.
data: 可考的數字大致如下。東魏方面的兵力，《北史·齊本紀》記高歡自蒲津濟、眾二十萬；西魏方面，《周書·文帝紀》記軍士不滿萬人。西魏出戰時只備三日口糧，營地距高歡大軍約六十里。戰果有三組不同的記數：《北史·周本紀》記斬六千餘級，又記前後虜其卒七萬；《北史·齊本紀》記東魏軍大亂、棄器甲十有八萬，而高歡一方自記喪甲士八萬人、丟棄鎧仗十之有八。追擊戰中西魏兵一直打到河上，斬獲甚眾。時間上，東魏天平四年、西魏大統十三年（537年）十月，高歡自蒲津南下，十月進抵洛水之南的許原，交戰在沙苑渭曲，具體日期傳世史籍多繫於十月之內。戰後論功，宇文泰升柱國大將軍、增邑五千戶，李弼等十二名將領一併進爵增邑；戰場上按當時在役兵士人數每人植柳一株。可作背景參照的是此前的小關之戰與河曲之戰，東魏在那一線已連敗於西魏，沙苑則是東魏第二次在關中門戶前折戟。
dataEn: The figures that can be relied on are roughly these. On the Eastern Wei side, the Bei Shi in the Ji Benji records that Gao Huan crossed at Puzhou with a host of 200,000; on the Western Wei side, the Zhou Shu in the Wendi ben records that the soldiers did not number even 10,000. The Western Wei marched out with only three days of rations and camped about sixty li from Gao Huan's main army. Three different sets of numbers describe the result: the Bei Shi in the Zhou Benji records more than 6,000 heads taken and also that some 70,000 of the enemy were captured in all, while the Bei Shi in the Qi Benji records that the Eastern Wei army was thrown into confusion and abandoned 180,000 suits of armour and equipment, and that Gao Huan's side lost 80,000 armoured soldiers and eight tenths of its armour and weapons. In the pursuit the Western Wei fought down to the river, taking heavy toll. In time, the battle fell in the tenth month of Tianping 4 of Eastern Wei, Datong 13 of Western Wei (537): Gao Huan moved south from Puzhou, reached Xu Yuan south of the Luo River within that month, and the fighting took place at Shayuan and Weiqu, the exact day being placed by the transmitted histories within the tenth month. After the victory Yuwen Tai was raised to Grand General of the Pillar of State and granted five thousand further households, and twelve commanders including Li Bi were likewise raised in rank with additions to their fiefs; as many willows were planted on the field as there were soldiers then in the service. For background one may set the battle against the earlier Xiaoguan and Hequ engagements, in which Eastern Wei had already been beaten by Western Wei on this front; Shayuan was the second failure of Eastern Wei at the gateway west of Guanzhong.
cause: 沙苑之戰的直接起因，是東魏新主高歡要在關中開一條路。534年北魏孝武帝西奔關中投奔宇文泰，高歡另立元善見於鄴，東西魏由此分立；此後數年，東魏在河北、河南重新站穩腳跟，而西魏則靠關中六鎮舊部與關東降將建立起關隴集團的雛形。535至536年間，西魏先後在河曲、小關兩戰打敗東魏，宇文泰又乘勢攻入東魏的盤豆、恆農兩郡，俘虜陝州刺史李徽伯，關東人心浮動。這使高歡判斷：西魏外強中乾、關中人稀兵少、內部整合未久，正是用兵關中的最佳時機。於是537年十月，他自晉陽盡發河北之兵，率二十萬眾南下蒲津，聲稱直取長安，目標明確：先破潼關，再取關中，把東魏的疆域推過黃河與渭河，完成北方的統一。西魏沒有退路，關中一失，宇文泰與孝武帝所倚的根基便無所附著，因此即便兵不滿萬、糧僅三日，宇文泰仍親率主力北上迎戰，並選擇在沙苑這片蘆葦縱橫、渭水北折的河曲地帶，用一次伏擊把兵力差距轉化成可以利用的弱點。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the battle at Shayuan was that the new master of Eastern Wei, Gao Huan, wanted a road into Guanzhong. In 534 Emperor Xiaowu of Northern Wei fled west to Guanzhong and took refuge with Yuwen Tai, while Gao Huan set up Yuan Shanxian at Ye, and from then the Eastern and Western Wei stood apart. In the years that followed, Eastern Wei re-established itself in Hebei and Henan, while Western Wei built the embryo of the Guanzhong group out of the old Six Garrisons families and the surrendered generals of the east. Between 535 and 536 Western Wei beat Eastern Wei at Hequ and at Xiaoguan, and Yuwen Tai followed up by taking the Eastern Wei commanderies of Pandou and Hengnong and taking the Inspector of Shan Prefecture, Li Huibo, prisoner; hearts in the east were unsettled. This led Gao Huan to judge that Western Wei was strong on the surface but hollow within, that Guanzhong was short of people and soldiers, and that its new order was not yet consolidated, and that this was the best moment to strike in Guanzhong. So in October 537 he raised the armies of Hebei from Jinyang and marched south at Puzhou with 200,000 men, declaring his aim to take Chang'an; his object was plain, to break Tong Pass first, take Guanzhong next, and push Eastern Wei's frontier across the Yellow and Wei rivers to complete the unification of the north. Western Wei had no room to retreat, for if Guanzhong fell the foundation on which Yuwen Tai and the court stood would dissolve, and so even with fewer than 10,000 men and three days of grain Yuwen Tai led his main force north to meet the enemy, choosing the reed-choked bend of the Wei River at Shayuan, where a difference in numbers could be turned into a weakness to be used.
impact: 沙苑之戰的影響，遠大於它本身的戰果。第一，西魏從此站穩關中，東魏不能再隨意越過潼關進入關中，兩國實際控制線固定在潼關與河東一帶，北方的主戰場由關中轉移到河東與河南，高歡此後的攻勢集中在洛陽方向，並有河曲之戰、河橋之戰、邙山之戰、玉壁之戰一連串拉鋸。第二，宇文泰的地位由此空前鞏固，他受封柱國大將軍、增邑五千戶，李弼等十二將進爵增邑，關隴軍事集團的權力結構在戰後成形，關中得以推行屯田與府兵之制，逐漸積累出足以支撐後來北周乃至隋唐的兵制與地盤。第三，東魏內部的權力格局也由此改變，高歡雖在野戰中失利，卻借戰敗之際整合河北軍權、加速消滅異己，孫騰、侯景與高氏一系的矛盾反而加劇，最終在北齊年間以高歡之死為界全面爆發。第四，從全局看，此役讓北方的統一推遲了數十年，西魏得以在關中養精蓄銳，直到550年代宇文泰、楊堅先後掌握西魏與北周的政權，才重新西向，把北齊壓回河北。
impactEn: The effects of the battle at Shayuan reached far beyond its immediate results. First, Western Wei stood firm in Guanzhong and Eastern Wei could no longer cross Tong Pass at will; the practical line between the two states settled at Tong Pass and the Hedong region, and the main theatre of northern war moved from Guanzhong to Hedong and Henan. Gao Huan's offensives concentrated thereafter on the Luoyang front, and the long string of contests that followed, at Hequ, Heqiao, Mangshan and Yubi, grew out of this new geography. Second, Yuwen Tai's position became unassailable: he was honoured as Grand General of the Pillar of State with five thousand additional households, and Li Bi and the other twelve commanders were raised in rank, so that the power structure of the Guanzhong military group took shape after the victory. Guanzhong could then institute tuntian and the fubing system, accumulating over time the troops and the territory that would one day support Northern Zhou and, through it, the Sui and the Tang. Third, the balance of power inside Eastern Wei also changed: although Gao Huan lost a field battle, he used the defeat to tighten his hold on the Hebei armies and to remove his rivals more quickly, and the friction between the Sun Teng and Hou Jing faction and the Gao clan grew sharper, until it broke out openly after Gao Huan's death in the years of Northern Qi. Fourth, in the larger view, the battle postponed northern unification by several decades. Western Wei was given the time to husband its strength in Guanzhong, and only when Yuwen Tai and then Yang Jian had taken over Western Wei and Northern Zhou in the 550s did the offensive resume, pressing Northern Qi back into Hebei.
result: 結果是西魏完勝，而且是一場典型的以弱勝強伏擊戰。高歡的前軍在渭曲被切為兩段，軍心崩潰，點名官回報各營已空、無人應答，在斛律金力勸下才勉強東撤，渡河時幾乎尋不到船，鎧仗絕大部分棄在沙苑。史載高歡喪甲士八萬人，丟棄鎧仗十之有八；《北史》記西魏斬六千餘級、前後虜其卒七萬，追擊直打到河上。高敖曹在恆農一線的圍攻隨之瓦解，率眾退保洛陽，東魏這次進攻關中完全失敗。勝利之後，宇文泰下令在戰場上按當時在役兵士人數每人植柳樹一株以旌武功，並以柱國大將軍、增邑五千戶受封，李弼等十二將進爵增邑。東魏並未因此一蹶不振，高歡仍牢牢控制河北與河南，兩國的對峙又延續了半個多世紀，直到550年代才由西魏與北周一方主動改變攻守格局。
resultEn: The result was a complete Western Wei victory, and a classic ambush won by the weaker side. Gao Huan's advance was cut in two at Weiqu and the nerve of the army broke; the name-taker reported that every camp was empty and no one answered, and only Hulü Jin's urging got the flight moving, the river crossing completed in disorder for want of boats and with the bulk of the armour left behind on the field at Shayuan. The histories record that Gao Huan lost 80,000 armoured soldiers and abandoned eight tenths of his armour and weapons; the Bei Shi records more than 6,000 heads taken by Western Wei and some 70,000 of the enemy captured, with the pursuit carried right down to the river. The siege at Hengnong collapsed at the same time, and Gao Ao'cao withdrew to Luoyang; this Eastern Wei offensive into Guanzhong had failed outright. After the victory Yuwen Tai ordered that on the field every soldier then in the service should plant one willow tree to record the achievement, and he was honoured as Grand General of the Pillar of State with five thousand further households, while twelve commanders including Li Bi were raised in rank and enfeoffed. Eastern Wei was not ruined by the defeat. Gao Huan still held Hebei and Henan firmly, and the standoff between the two states lasted for more than half a century, until in the 550s the side that had stood on the defensive chose to change the pattern of the war.
